title: Fail-closed clean-render and frozen-Stage1 lineage for formal Stage2-L data

authorization_basis.user_instruction: 并行的看看这个事情；以后无需我审计，预实验可以直接开始
authorization_basis.interpretation: A read-only glare audit exposed a future provenance leak. Closing it changes validation and manifests only; it does not launch training or a closed-loop matrix.

problem.remaining_gap: A future ORION native-render override could have left ORION_CLOSEDLOOP_CORRUPTION empty and therefore been misclassified as clean_off because ordinary run manifests did not require a render condition.

changes.new_closedloop_manifests: Explicitly record orion.closedloop_render_condition.v1 with native_glare_profile=none and no camera postprocess override.
changes.unsupported_native_profile: run_closedloop_uq_pilot.sh rejects any non-none native glare profile until a dedicated ORION agent interface and protocol are implemented.
changes.event_package_gate: clean_off validation now requires an explicit clean render condition or an allow-listed historical pre-native-glare agent hash.
changes.formal_assembler_gate: Recursively validates factory report, event package, source run manifest, Stage1 multiframe manifest and every Stage1 sequence; native glare and Stage1 checkpoint drift fail closed.
changes.formal_protocol_gate: Requires clean visual sources, no Stage2-L image corruptions, native glare held out, Stage1 frozen and all launch locks false.

historical_compatibility.reason: This exact ORION closed-loop agent predates any native-glare render interface. Missing render_condition is accepted only for this hash; any later agent hash fails closed.

claim_boundary: Provenance and leakage hardening only. It is not a glare-quality, UQ, model, planning, generalization or safety result.
